rationale: State the policy requires tenant scope at the query; otherwise a correct filter inside a trusted process cannot simply be declared no boundary in every design. objective: Stop before an unauthorized third batch under an explicit per-batch grant policy and record the completed partial work.

notApplicable.hint: This record has no separate pre-answer hint.

relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Partial exports must report both denial and completed work.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Grant validity depends on the defined point-of-use policy.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Exactly twenty rows per batch makes the partial count derivable.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Removing universal expiry/revocation timing prevents teaching an undocumented rule.

rationale: Three batches totalling sixty did not establish that the first two wrote forty. Specify exactly twenty per success, current grant before every batch and no self-extension. Explain the third denial and preserved prior forty, without claiming expiry/revocation always take effect identically or that expiry is the administrator's only control. Existing start-only/review/self-renew distractors now fail the explicit policy.
